module Splice.Wallet.Payment where

import DA.List (dedupSort)
import DA.Time

import Splice.Util
import Splice.Amulet
import Splice.AmuletRules
import Splice.Expiry
import Splice.Round
import Splice.Types

data Unit
  = USDUnit
  | AmuletUnit
  | ExtUnit
      -- ^ Extension constructor to work around the current lack of upgrading for variants in Daml 3.0.
      -- Will serve as the default value in a containing record in case of an extension.
  deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

data AppPaymentRequest_ExpireResult = AppPaymentRequest_ExpireResult with
  terminatedAppPayment : ContractId TerminatedAppPayment

data AppPaymentRequest_AcceptResult = AppPaymentRequest_AcceptResult with
  acceptedPayment : ContractId AcceptedAppPayment
  senderChangeAmulet : Optional (ContractId Amulet)

data AppPaymentRequest_WithdrawResult = AppPaymentRequest_WithdrawResult with
  terminatedAppPayment : ContractId TerminatedAppPayment

data AppPaymentRequest_RejectResult = AppPaymentRequest_RejectResult with
  terminatedAppPayment : ContractId TerminatedAppPayment

data AcceptedAppPayment_RejectResult = AcceptedAppPayment_RejectResult with
  amulet : AmuletCreateSummary (ContractId Amulet)

data AcceptedAppPayment_ExpireResult = AcceptedAppPayment_ExpireResult with
  amulet : AmuletCreateSummary (ContractId Amulet)

data PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount
  with
    amount : Decimal
    unit : Unit
  deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

data ReceiverAmount = ReceiverAmount
 with
   receiver : Party
   amount : PaymentAmount
 deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data ReceiverAmuletAmount = ReceiverAmuletAmount
 with
   receiver : Party
   amuletAmount : Decimal
 deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

paymentAmountToAmulet : Party -> OpenMiningRound -> PaymentAmount -> Update Decimal
paymentAmountToAmulet dso openMiningRound pq =
  case pq.unit of
    USDUnit ->
      do
        require "matching DSO party" (openMiningRound.dso == dso)
        pure (pq.amount / openMiningRound.amuletPrice)
    AmuletUnit ->
      pure pq.amount
    ExtUnit -> error "ExtUnit: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

receiverAmountToAmuletReceiverAmount : Party -> OpenMiningRound -> ReceiverAmount -> Update ReceiverAmuletAmount
receiverAmountToAmuletReceiverAmount dso openMiningRound rq =
  do
    amulet <- paymentAmountToAmulet dso openMiningRound rq.amount
    pure ReceiverAmuletAmount with
      receiver = rq.receiver
      amuletAmount = amulet

appPaymentRequest_receivers : AppPaymentRequest -> [Party]
appPaymentRequest_receivers AppPaymentRequest{..} = map (\r -> r.receiver) receiverAmounts

template AppPaymentRequest
  with
    sender : Party -- ^ The party that should pay.

createPaymentRequest : AmuletApp -> Party -> Party -> [(Party, PaymentAmount)] -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
createPaymentRequest app provider sender receiverAmounts = do
  t <- getTime
  let description = "multi, sender: " <> show sender <> ", amount: " <> show receiverAmounts
  -- multi-party submit to simplify test
  submitMulti (sender :: provider :: map fst receiverAmounts) [] $ createCmd AppPaymentRequest with
    sender
    provider
    dso = app.dso
    receiverAmounts = map (uncurry ReceiverAmount) receiverAmounts
    expiresAt = t `addRelTime` minutes 5
    description

createSingleReceiverPaymentRequest : AmuletApp -> Party -> Party -> Party -> PaymentAmount -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
createSingleReceiverPaymentRequest app provider sender receiver amount = do
  createPaymentRequest app provider sender [(receiver, amount)]

acceptPaymentRequest : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> Party -> Optional(ContractId FeaturedAppRight) -> ContractId AppPaymentRequest -> ContractId Amulet -> Script (ContractId AcceptedAppPayment)
acceptPaymentRequest app sender walletProvider providerFeaturedAppRight transferRequest amulet = do
  context <- getPaymentTransferContextFeaturedApp app sender providerFeaturedAppRight
  -- TODO(#2957): remove read-as DSO party.
  result <- submitMulti [sender.primaryParty, walletProvider] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd transferRequest AppPaymentRequest_Accept with
    inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
    context
    walletProvider

      -- Will serve as the default value in a containing record in case of an extension.
  deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

data AppPaymentRequest_AcceptResult = AppPaymentRequest_AcceptResult with

  senderChangeAmulet : Optional (ContractId Amulet)

data AppPaymentRequest_WithdrawResult = AppPaymentRequest_WithdrawResult with

data AppPaymentRequest_RejectResult = AppPaymentRequest_RejectResult with

data PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount

    unit : Unit

data ReceiverAmount = ReceiverAmount
 with
   receiver : Party

 deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data ReceiverAmuletAmount = ReceiverAmuletAmount
 with
   receiver : Party
   amuletAmount : Decimal
 deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

paymentAmountToAmulet : Party -> OpenMiningRound -> PaymentAmount -> Update Decimal
paymentAmountToAmulet dso openMiningRound pq =
  case pq.unit of
    USDUnit ->
      do
        require "matching DSO party" (openMiningRound.dso == dso)
        pure (pq.amount / openMiningRound.amuletPrice)
    AmuletUnit ->
      pure pq.amount
    ExtUnit -> error "ExtUnit: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

receiverAmountToAmuletReceiverAmount : Party -> OpenMiningRound -> ReceiverAmount -> Update ReceiverAmuletAmount
receiverAmountToAmuletReceiverAmount dso openMiningRound rq =
  do
    amulet <- paymentAmountToAmulet dso openMiningRound rq.amount
    pure ReceiverAmuletAmount with
      receiver = rq.receiver
      amuletAmount = amulet

    provider

acceptPaymentRequest app sender walletProvider providerFeaturedAppRight transferRequest amulet = do
  context <- getPaymentTransferContextFeaturedApp app sender providerFeaturedAppRight
  -- TODO(#2957): remove read-as DSO party.

collectAcceptedPaymentInRound app round provider acceptedAppPayment = do
  Some acceptedPayment <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedAppPayment
  context <- getAppTransferContextForRound app provider round
  -- multi party submit to simplify test
  submitMulti (signatory acceptedPayment) [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd acceptedAppPayment (AcceptedAppPayment_Collect context)

collectAcceptedPaymentMustFail app provider acceptedAppPayment = do
  Some acceptedPayment <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedAppPayment

  -- multi party submit to simplify test
  _ <- submitMultiMustFail (signatory acceptedPayment) [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd acceptedAppPayment (AcceptedAppPayment_Collect context)

  featuredAppRight <- queryFilter @FeaturedAppRight app.dso (\co -> co.provider == preapproval.provider)
  let receiverProviderFeaturedRight = listToOptional (fmap fst featuredAppRight)

  [(senderWalletInstall, _)] <- query @WalletAppInstall sender.primaryParty
  featuredAppRight <- queryFilter @FeaturedAppRight app.dso (\co -> co.provider == sender.primaryParty)
  let senderProviderFeaturedRight = listToOptional (fmap fst featuredAppRight)

  amulets <- query @Amulet sender.primaryParty
  context <- getPaymentTransferContextFeaturedApp app sender senderProviderFeaturedRight
  WalletAppInstall_ExecuteBatchResult { outcomes } <- submitMulti [senderWalletProvider.primaryParty] [sender.primaryParty, app.dso] $ exerciseCmd senderWalletInstall WalletAppInstall_ExecuteBatch with
    inputs = fmap ((\amulet -> InputAmulet amulet) . fst) amulets
    operations = [CO_TransferPreapprovalSend preapprovalCid receiverProviderFeaturedRight amount (Some "wallet-app-install-preapproval-send-description")]
    context
  pure (head outcomes)

checkAmuletPositions owner expectedAmounts = do
    let ownerParty = owner.primaryParty
    actualAmulets <- queryFilter @Amulet ownerParty (\c -> c.owner == ownerParty)
    sort (map (._2.amount.initialAmount) actualAmulets) === sort expectedAmounts

+module Splice.Scripts.Wallet.TestTransferOffers where
+
+import DA.Assert
+import DA.Time
+import Daml.Script
+
+import Splice.Wallet.Payment
+import Splice.Wallet.TransferOffer
+
+makeOffer : Party -> Party -> Party -> Time -> Script (ContractId TransferOffer)
+makeOffer sender receiver dso expiresAt =
+  submit sender "'$ createCmd TransferOffer with
+    sender
+    receiver
+    dso
+    amount = PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
+    description = "test transfer"
+    expiresAt
+    trackingId = "offer-123"
+
+testTransferOfferAccept : Script ()
+testTransferOfferAccept = script do
+  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
+  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
+  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
+  now <- getTime
+  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
+  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
+  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
+  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
+  Some details <- queryContractId sender accepted
+  details.sender === sender
+  details.receiver === receiver
+  details.dso === outsider
+  details.amount === PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
+  details.expiresAt === now `addRelTime` minutes 5
+  details.trackingId === "offer-123"
+  None <- queryContractId sender offer
+  pure ()
+
+testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw : Script ()
+testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw = script do
+  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
+  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
+  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
+  now <- getTime
+  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
+  rejected <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
+  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
+  TransferOffer_RejectResult rejectedInfo <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
+  rejectedInfo === expected
+  None <- queryContractId sender rejected
+  withdrawn <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
+  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
+  TransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawnInfo <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
+  withdrawnInfo === expected
+  None <- queryContractId sender withdrawn
+  pure ()
+
+testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation : Script ()
+testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation = script do
+  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
+  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
+  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
+  now <- getTime
+  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
+  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
+  first <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
+  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForWithdraw <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd first TransferOffer_Accept
+  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
+  AcceptedTransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawn <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
+  withdrawn === expected
+  None <- queryContractId sender acceptedForWithdraw
+  second <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
+  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForAbort <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd second TransferOffer_Accept
+  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
+  AcceptedTransferOffer_AbortResult aborted <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
+  aborted === expected
+  None <- queryContractId receiver acceptedForAbort
+  pure ()
+
+testTransferOfferExpiry : Script ()
+testTransferOfferExpiry = script do
+  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
+  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
+  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
+  now <- getTime
+  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
+  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
+  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
+  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
+  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
+  acceptedOffer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
+  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedOffer TransferOffer_Accept
+  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
+  passTime (minutes 5)
+  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
+  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
+  TransferOffer_ExpireResult expired <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
+  expired === expected
+  None <- queryContractId sender offer
+  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
+  AcceptedTransferOffer_ExpireResult acceptedExpired <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
+  acceptedExpired === expected
+  None <- queryContractId receiver accepted
+  pure ()

item.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat > daml/splice-wallet-test/daml/Splice/Scripts/Wallet/TestTransferOffers.daml <<'EOF'
module Splice.Scripts.Wallet.TestTransferOffers where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

import Splice.Wallet.Payment
import Splice.Wallet.TransferOffer

makeOffer : Party -> Party -> Party -> Time -> Script (ContractId TransferOffer)
makeOffer sender receiver dso expiresAt =
  submit sender "'$ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso
    amount = PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
    description = "test transfer"
    expiresAt
    trackingId = "offer-123"

testTransferOfferAccept : Script ()
testTransferOfferAccept = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  Some details <- queryContractId sender accepted
  details.sender === sender
  details.receiver === receiver
  details.dso === outsider
  details.amount === PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
  details.expiresAt === now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  details.trackingId === "offer-123"
  None <- queryContractId sender offer
  pure ()

testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw : Script ()
testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  rejected <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
  TransferOffer_RejectResult rejectedInfo <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
  rejectedInfo === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender rejected
  withdrawn <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
  TransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawnInfo <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
  withdrawnInfo === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender withdrawn
  pure ()

testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation : Script ()
testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  first <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForWithdraw <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd first TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
  AcceptedTransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawn <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
  withdrawn === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender acceptedForWithdraw
  second <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForAbort <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd second TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
  AcceptedTransferOffer_AbortResult aborted <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
  aborted === expected
  None <- queryContractId receiver acceptedForAbort
  pure ()

testTransferOfferExpiry : Script ()
testTransferOfferExpiry = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
  acceptedOffer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedOffer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  passTime (minutes 5)
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
  TransferOffer_ExpireResult expired <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
  expired === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender offer
  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
  AcceptedTransferOffer_ExpireResult acceptedExpired <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  acceptedExpired === expected
  None <- queryContractId receiver accepted
  pure ()
EOF
cd daml/splice-wallet && daml build'

  AcceptedTransferOffer_ExpireResult acceptedExpired <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  acceptedExpired === expected
  None <- queryContractId receiver accepted
  pure ()
EOF

-- | Smart constructor for inputing validator faucet coupons into a transfer.

-- | Representation of a batch transfer.
data Transfer = Transfer with
    sender : Party
    provider : Party
    inputs : [TransferInput]
    outputs : [TransferOutput]
    beneficiaries : Optional [AppRewardBeneficiary]
      -- ^ Beneficiaries between which the app reward is split.
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)


-- | An individual output for a batch transfer.
data TransferOutput = TransferOutput with
    receiver : Party -- ^ The receiver who will own the created output amulet.
    receiverFeeRatio : Decimal
      -- ^ The ratio of the output fee paid from receiver's output amount.
      -- 1.0 means the whole fee is deducted from the specified output amount,
      -- 0.0 the whole fee is deducted from the sender's input balance.
      --
      -- If a receiver's fee is not covered by the specified output amount, the transfer is aborted.
    amount : Decimal
      -- ^ The amount of amulet to receive, before deducting the receiver's part of the output fee.
    lock : Optional TimeLock -- ^ The lock to be added, if any.
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data TransferResult
  = TransferResult
  with
    round: Round -- ^ Round for which this transfer was registered.
    summary: TransferSummary -- ^ Summary of amount input and outputs, and fees paid.
    createdAmulets: [CreatedAmulet] -- ^ References to the created output amulets.
    senderChangeAmulet: Optional (ContractId Amulet)
exercisePaymentTransfer : Party -> PaymentTransferContext -> Transfer -> Update TransferResult
exercisePaymentTransfer expectedDso PaymentTransferContext{..} transfer = do
  exercise amuletRules AmuletRules_Transfer with
    transfer
    context
    expectedDso = Some expectedDso

exerciseComputeFees : Party -> PaymentTransferContext -> Party -> [TransferOutput] -> Update [Decimal]
exerciseComputeFees expectedDso PaymentTransferContext{..} sender outputs = do
  feesResult <- exercise amuletRules AmuletRules_ComputeFees with
        context
        sender
        outputs
        expectedDso = Some expectedDso
  return feesResult.fees

data PaymentTransferContext = PaymentTransferContext
  with
    amuletRules : ContractId AmuletRules
    context : TransferContext
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | Contracts that need to be passed in to a Transfer so that
-- we can reference them by contract id instead of by key.
data TransferContext = TransferContext
  with
    openMiningRound : ContractId OpenMiningRound
    issuingMiningRounds : Map Round (ContractId IssuingMiningRound)
    validatorRights : Map Party (ContractId ValidatorRight) -- ^ Map from user to ValidatorRight contract.
    featuredAppRight : Optional (ContractId FeaturedAppRight) -- ^ Optional proof that the provider is a featured app provider.
  deriving (Show, Eq)
getAppTransferContextForRound app provider round = do
  openMiningRounds <- getOpenRoundsSorted app
  openMiningRound <- case find (\(_, payload) -> payload.round == round) openMiningRounds of
        None -> abort ("No open mining round for round " <> show round)
        Some (cid, _) -> pure cid
  amuletRules <- fst <$> fetchAmuletRulesByKey app.dso
  featuredAppRight <- getFeaturedAppRight app provider.primaryParty
  pure AppTransferContext with
    amuletRules
    openMiningRound
    featuredAppRight

getPaymentTransferContextFeaturedApp : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> Optional(ContractId FeaturedAppRight) -> Script PaymentTransferContext
getPaymentTransferContextFeaturedApp app user featuredAppRight = do
  context <- getTransferContext app user featuredAppRight
  amuletRules <- fst <$> fetchAmuletRulesByKey app.dso
  pure PaymentTransferContext with ..


getTransferContext : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> Optional(ContractId FeaturedAppRight) -> Script TransferContext
getTransferContext app user featuredAppRight = do
  openMiningRound <- fst <$> getLatestOpenRound app

item.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat >> daml/splice-wallet-test/daml/Splice/Scripts/Wallet/TestTransferOffers.daml <<'EOF'

testTransferOfferFieldLimits : Script ()
testTransferOfferFieldLimits = script do
  sender <- allocateParty \"sender\"
  receiver <- allocateParty \"receiver\"
  now <- getTime
  let shortText = foldl (<>) \"\" (replicate 279 \"x\")
  let longText = shortText <> \"x\"
  _ <- submit sender "'$ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = shortText
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = shortText
  submitMustFail sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = longText
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = "valid"
  submitMustFail sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = "valid"
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = longText
  pure ()

testCompleteAcceptedTransferOffer : Script ()
testCompleteAcceptedTransferOffer = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app
  amulet <- tap app alice 42.0
  now <- getTime
  let sender = alice.primaryParty
  let receiver = bob.primaryParty
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver app.dso (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  transferContext <- getPaymentTransferContext app alice
  let walletProvider = aliceValidator.primaryParty
  submitMultiMustFail [sender] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Complete with
    inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
    transferContext
    walletProvider
  AcceptedTransferOffer_CompleteResult{..} <- submitMulti [sender, walletProvider] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Complete with
    inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
    transferContext
    walletProvider
  trackingInfo === TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  senderChangeAmulet === transferResult.senderChangeAmulet
  [(receiverAmuletCid, receiverAmulet)] <- query @Amulet receiver
  receiverAmulet.amount.initialAmount === 12.0
  None <- queryContractId sender accepted
  pure ()
EOF
# Add required imports without touching implementation files
sed -i '"'/import DA.Time/a import Splice.Amulet\\nimport Splice.AmuletRules\\nimport Splice.Scripts.Util' daml/splice-wallet-test/daml/Splice/Scripts/Wallet/TestTransferOffers.daml
cd daml/splice-wallet-test && daml test --files daml/Splice/Scripts/Wallet/TestTransferOffers.daml"
